name: Agentlas OS
description: Keeps specialist agents in a local-first hub and spins up a temporary orchestrator per task, staffing it from local, cloud, and hub agents via CLI or a stdio MCP server.

skills.name: Workforce Staffing
skills.description: Searches local, owner cloud, and public hub menus for candidate roles; the calling model makes the staffing decision.

skills.name: Execution Preparation
skills.description: Fetches bring-your-own-model runtime bundles for an accepted roster, pinning release and content hashes.

skills.name: Tool Search
skills.description: Finds the specific tool for a one-sentence action across installed servers, with read-only and destructive hints.

skills.name: Plugin Resolution
skills.description: Matches a missing capability against installed plugins and the hub catalog without installing anything.

skills.name: Context Map
skills.description: Locates code, slices references, and traces changed files or symbols through reverse references and dependencies.
